title: Presentations · Powerpoint templates
slide_intent: Select a slide form according to the audience’s task. A photograph can carry a story, a chapter card marks a transition, and a few large words can hold attention on one idea.
strategic_value: A common master and a small range of slide types can help program presentations remain recognizable through changes of content and pace.
demonstration: Five examples show a title, text page, full-image page, chapter break and large-text point. The notes describe changing program identification in the master and footer.
practical_value: Localize the master once, then choose a slide type for each message. Use the pictured chapter card to separate sections and the image layout when a photograph can carry the point.

content_islands.name: Template instructions
content_islands.spec: List master and footer edits beside numbered rules for images, breaks and short statements. Include the PDF-sharing note beneath.

content_islands.name: Slide-type comparison
content_islands.spec: Show two larger examples across the top and three smaller slides beneath. Number the cover, body, image, chapter and statement examples to match the instructions.
